source: Third, closer does not mean automatically better. Moving data into shared memory costs instructions and often synchronization. Keeping more values in registers can increase register pressure. A cache may contain data that is never reused. Each level helps only when the access pattern makes its cost worthwhile.
zh: 第三，更接近并不意味着自动更好。将数据移入共享内存需要指令并且通常需要同步。在寄存器中保留更多值会增加寄存器压力。缓存可能包含从未重用的数据。仅当访问模式值得其成本时，每个级别才有帮助。
